_comment: Offline snapshot of the Woolsey TV Dashboard Airtable base, used only for local preview when AIRTABLE_TOKEN is not set. CI always reads the live base. Keys are table IDs.

fields.Title: Buyer's Premium
fields.Body: 12% — or 10% if you pay in person today with cash, check, or money order.

fields.Title: Payment Deadline
fields.Body: Pay by 4:30 PM on your pickup day to get the 10% rate. After that, the card on file is charged automatically at 12%.

fields.Title: Loading Is Your Responsibility
fields.Body: Bring your own help, vehicle, straps, and tools. Our staff show you where your items are and lend a hand — they are not a loading crew. Machinery is never guaranteed.

fields.Title: Onsite Auctions: Pickup Is Your Only Chance
fields.Body: When pickup ends we hand back the keys and lose all access. Anything left behind is thrown away or stays with the property. No refunds.

fields.Title: Storage — Canon City Only
fields.Body: $10 per lot, per day, starting the morning after pickup closes. Items are deemed abandoned after the third day.

fields.Title: Can't Make Your Pickup?
fields.Body: Email info@woolseyauction.com BEFORE your window. We work with people who tell us in advance.

fields.Title: Firearms: 3-Day Wait
fields.Body: Colorado law requires a three-day waiting period. On pickup day you start your 4473 and background check — you will not leave with the firearm that day.

fields.Title: Sales Tax
fields.Body: 8.7% at our Canon City building. The rate follows where the auction is held, not where you live.

fields.Value: Questions? Ask at the counter or call 719-275-1439
